_usage: Copy individual server blocks into your own .claude/settings.json. Never copy credentials — always use ${ENV_VAR} references.

filesystem._comment: Grants Claude read/write access to specified directory trees. Scope to the narrowest path needed.

postgres._comment: Connects Claude to a PostgreSQL database. Always use a read-only user. Never point at production.

env._comment_env: PGPASSWORD is read by libpq; never put the password in the connection string directly.

sqlite._comment: Connects Claude to a local SQLite file. No credentials required. Useful for local dev and prototyping.

github._comment: Connects Claude to GitHub. Use a fine-grained PAT scoped to specific repos with read-only permissions.
github._pat_scopes: Contents: read, Issues: read, Pull Requests: read, Metadata: read

slack._comment: Connects Claude to Slack. Create a dedicated Slack app; scope the bot token to channels:history and channels:read only.

puppeteer._comment: Gives Claude a headless browser. Use for local/staging smoke tests only — never against production.

jira._comment: Custom MCP server wrapping the Jira REST API. See examples/custom-mcp-server.ts for the implementation.
jira._token_scopes: Read: browse projects, view issues. Write not granted — use a read-only API token.
